archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY / WARM MINIMALIST LAW TECH

entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand identity & features overview left, Moroccan legal dashboard preview right
entry_surfaces./login: branded split login — positioning panel with Moroccan legal justice badge left, Google Emergent auth panel right

rtl_considerations: Use logical Tailwind utility classes (e.g., ms-, me-, ps-, pe-, start-0, end-0, rtl:rotate-180 for back arrows)
Ensure navigation sidebar docks on the right in RTL mode and left in English mode
Stat numbers and Moroccan Dirham (MAD / د.م) currency indicators formatted properly
Dates displayed with Moroccan judicial context (e.g. 15 مارس 2026 / 15 Mars 2026)

core_pages_and_components.description: Center of operations: Quick stats (Active Cases, Today's Hearings, Pending Drafts, Clients count), Today's & This Week's Court Hearings / Appointments, Urgent Actions log, and Moroccan Court status timeline
Grid & Table view of Clients with CNIE / Passport, phone, email, city/address, case count, notes, and quick case link drawer

Comprehensive Moroccan case tracker: File number (رقم الملف e.g., 2026/1201/45), Court name (محكمة الاستئناف بالدار البيضاء / المحكمة الابتدائية / المحكمة التجارية), Opponent (الخصم), Judge/Counsel, Status tabs (Ongoing, Postponed, Judged, Archived), Hearings & Actions log, and File Attachment manager (PDF/Images/Word)
Interactive Month & Week view of judicial hearings (جلسات) and client appointments. Color-coded by urgency and court level with Mahakim session reminders.

Rich legal document creator: Templates for Moroccan legal practice (مقال افتتاحي للدعوى, مذكرة جوابية, عقد كراء تجاري, إنذار مباشر), AI-powered legal drafting assistant, Case association, and Export to Print/PDF.

Searchable legal database categorized into: 1. Legal Texts (النصوص التشريعية والمدونات - DOC, Code de commerce, Moudawana), 2. Court of Cassation Jurisprudence (اجتهادات محكمة النقض), 3. Legal Studies & Doctrine (دراسات وأبحاث). Filtering by domain: Civil, Criminal, Family, Commercial, Labor, Real-Estate.
Conversational Moroccan law AI with real-time streaming: context injection from specific case dossiers or legal library articles, conversation history, and legal disclaimer banner.
Role-based collaboration: Admin managing associates and staff via Emergent Google OAuth email whitelist.

image_urls.description: Professional lawyers signing legal contract at conference table, used for authentication background and app banner
Close-up of law textbook with justice scales on wooden desk covered in legal documents
Law firm discussion among attorneys in a contemporary office setting

instructions_to_main_agent: Default the application to Arabic RTL ('dir="rtl"' on documentElement or main container), but include a fluid Language Toggle (العربية / English) in the top navigation.
Implement Google authentication using Emergent OAuth flow with seamless session management and persistent auth state.
Provide rich pre-seeded mock data customized for Moroccan practice (e.g. Tribunal de Première Instance de Casablanca, Cour d'Appel de Rabat, Moudawana cases, Commercial rent litigation).
Ensure all buttons, form fields, and status indicators have corresponding data-testid attributes for testing.
Implement the AI chat with simulated streaming or direct response hook, featuring pre-configured legal prompts (صياغة مقال, تحليل عقد, استخراج دفوع).
In the Document Editor, provide 4 ready-to-use Moroccan templates that insert formal Moroccan legal structure (إلى السيد الرئيس المحترم، الوقائع، في الشكل، في الموضوع، لهذه الأسباب).
Preserve high contrast with warm terracotta/amber accents (#9A3412, #C2410C) against warm paper (#FAF7F2, #FFFFFF) and deep graphite (#1C1917) text.
